-- Edited by Harbinger451
-- StartsBy: Script
-- Questee: anyone with a pick-axe
Quest: MiningQuestWeakest
DisplayName: Mine for Gems or Elements
-- Message panels
QRC:

Message:  1013
<ce> Despite spending some time mining intensively,
<ce> you were unable to successfully mine anything of worth!

Message:  1014
<ce> Spending some time mining intensively,
<ce> you were able to find some _element1_!

Message:  1015
<ce> Spending some time mining intensively,
<ce> you were able to find some _element1_
<ce> and some _element2_!

Message:  1018
<ce> Spending some time mining intensively,
<ce> you were able to find some _gem1_!

Message:  1019
<ce> Spending some time mining intensively,
<ce> you were able to find some _gem1_
<ce> and some _gem2_!

QBN:

Item _element1_ element
Item _element2_ element
Item _gem1_ gem
Item _gem2_ gem
Item _weapon_ weapon
Item _armor_ armor
Item _magic_ magic_item
Item _misc_ misc
Item _flamable_ flamable
Item _trinket_ trinket
Item _book_ book
Item _potion_ potion
Item _map_ random_map
Item _coins_ gold range 1 to 8
Item _organ_ organs
Item _skin_ skin
Item _mythic_ mythic
Item _mineral_ mineral

-- Quest start-up:
	pc at any dungeon5 set _atmine_
	pick one of _gems_ _elements_

variable _atmine_

variable _gems_

variable _elements_

_desert_ task:
    climate desert

_desert2_ task:
    climate desert2

_mountain_ task:
	climate mountain

_mountainwoods_ task:
	climate mountainwoods

_weakluc_ task:
	when attribute Luck is at least 0

_evenluc_ task:
	when attribute Luck is at least 40

_strongluc_ task:
	when attribute Luck is at least 60

_verystrongluc_ task:
	when attribute Luck is at least 80

_worstchanceluc_ task:
	when _weakluc_ and not _evenluc_

_evenchanceluc_ task:
	when _evenluc_ and not _strongluc_

_goodchanceluc_ task:
	when _strongluc_ and not _verystrongluc_

_bestchanceluc_ task:
	when _verystrongluc_

_elementsbounty_ task:
	when _elements_ and _desert_ or _desert2_ or _mountain_ or _mountainwoods_ or _atmine_
	reduce player fatigue by 25
	raise time by 2:00
	pick one of _0element_ _0element_ _1element_ _1element_ _2element_

_gemsbounty_ task:
	when _gems_ and _desert_ or _desert2_ or _mountain_ or _mountainwoods_ or _atmine_
	reduce player fatigue by 25
	raise time by 2:00
	pick one of _0gem_ _0gem_ _1gem_ _1gem_ _2gem_

_elementsscare_ task:
	when _elements_ and not _desert_ or _desert2_ or _mountain_ or _mountainwoods_ or _atmine_
	reduce player fatigue by 25
	raise time by 2:00
	pick one of _0element_ _0element_ _0element_ _1element_ _1element_

_gemsscare_ task:
	when _gems_ and not _desert_ or _desert2_ or _mountain_ or _mountainwoods_ or _atmine_
	reduce player fatigue by 25
	raise time by 2:00
	pick one of _0gem_ _0gem_ _0gem_ _1gem_ _1gem_

_0element_ task:
	say 1013

_1element_ task:
	say 1014
	get item _element1_
	make _element1_ permanent

_2element_ task:
	say 1015
	get item _element1_
	make _element1_ permanent
	get item _element2_
	make _element2_ permanent

_0gem_ task:
	say 1013

_1gem_ task:
	say 1018
	get item _gem1_
	make _gem1_ permanent

_2gem_ task:
	say 1019
	get item _gem1_
	make _gem1_ permanent
	get item _gem2_
	make _gem2_ permanent

_mined_ task:
	when _0element_ or _1element_ or _2element_ or _0gem_ or _1gem_ or _2gem_

_bonusweak_ task:
	when _mined_ and _worstchanceluc_
	pick one of _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _1bonus_

_bonuseven_ task:
	when _mined_ and _evenchanceluc_
	pick one of _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _1bonus_ _1bonus_

_bonusgood_ task:
	when _mined_ and _goodchanceluc_
	pick one of _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _1bonus_ _1bonus_ _1bonus_

_bonusbest_ task:
	when _mined_ and _bestchanceluc_
	pick one of _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _1bonus_ _1bonus_ _1bonus_ _1bonus_

_0bonus_ task:
	end quest

_1bonus_ task:
	pick one of _randomingredient_ _randomingredient_ _randomingredient_ _randomingredient_ _randomitem_

_randomitem_ task:
	pick one of _weaponitem_ _armoritem_ _magicitem_ _bookitem_ _potionitem_ _mapitem_ _miscitem_
	
_randomingredient_ task:
	pick one of _coinsitem_ _flamableitem_ _flamableitem_ _organitem_ _skinitem_ _mythicitem_ _mineralitem_ _trinketitem_

_weaponitem_ task:
	update-quest-item _weapon_ Leveled
	say 1022
	get item _weapon_
	make _weapon_ permanent
	end quest

_armoritem_ task:
	update-quest-item _armor_ Leveled
	say 1023
	get item _armor_
	make _armor_ permanent
	end quest

_magicitem_ task:
	say 1024
	get item _magic_
	make _magic_ permanent
	end quest

_miscitem_ task:
	say 1025
	get item _misc_
	make _misc_ permanent
	end quest

_flamableitem_ task:
	say 1026
	get item _flamable_
	make _flamable_ permanent
	end quest

_trinketitem_ task:
	say 1027
	get item _trinket_
	make _trinket_ permanent
	end quest

_bookitem_ task:
	say 1028
	get item _book_
	make _book_ permanent
	end quest

_potionitem_ task:
	say 1029
	get item _potion_
	make _potion_ permanent
	end quest

_mapitem_ task:
	say 1030
	get item _map_
	make _map_ permanent
	end quest

_coinsitem_ task:
	say 1031
	get item _coins_
	make _coins_ permanent
	end quest

_organitem_ task:
	say 1032
	get item _organ_
	make _organ_ permanent
	end quest

_skinitem_ task:
	say 1033
	get item _skin_
	make _skin_ permanent
	end quest

_mythicitem_ task:
	say 1038
	get item _mythic_
	make _mythic_ permanent
	end quest

_mineralitem_ task:
	say 1039
	get item _mineral_
	make _mineral_ permanent
	end quest
